sloka: उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम् ।सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महामतिः ।। ७.९२.५ ॥
transliteration: upakāryā mahārhāśca pārthivānāṁ mahātmanām ।sānugānāṁ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahāmatiḥ ।। 7.92.5 ॥

translations.english: The great-minded Rama, the best among men, arranged for valuable and suitable lodgings for the great kings and their retinues.
